image_description: A full-body side view of an American Bison standing on a gravel path next to a grassy field. The bison has a massive, shaggy dark brown forequarter with a prominent shoulder hump and a large head with short curved horns. The hindquarters are less furry and darker. In the background, there is a mountain range and some sparse trees under a blue sky.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible in profile, showing a broad structure and short, upward-curving black horns consistent with the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct beard of long, dark hair hangs from the chin and throat area, matching the taxonomy description.
The eye is visible as a small dark spot on the side of the head, consistent with the description.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and partially obscured by the thick fur of the head/hump, which is accurate for bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits a massive build with a significant height difference between the shoulder hump and the hips, characteristic of bison anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The forequarters are covered in thick, textured, dark brown fur that creates a very pronounced shoulder hump.
There is a clear visual transition where the fur becomes shorter and smoother on the rear half of the body compared to the front.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are relatively small in proportion to the massive head and body, fitting the 'short' descriptor.
The visible legs are thick and sturdy. While the hooves are partially obscured by grass/gravel, the lower leg structure is consistent with ungulate anatomy, and no deformities are visible.
The tail is visible hanging down, ending in a distinct dark, bushy tuft, matching the description.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification (American Bison vs. European Bison or other bovids) and ensure high-level semantic alignment.
To verify the structural integrity of the four legs and the connection of the limbs to the massive torso, checking for any subtle fusion or missing limb artifacts common in AI generation.
To analyze the texture consistency of the shaggy fur against the smoother hindquarters and check for edge bleeding between the animal and the complex background (grass/mountains).
To ensure the bison is correctly grounded on the gravel path and separated from the background mountains, checking for any spatial flattening or melting.

focus_areas: Fur texture transition between forequarters and hindquarters
Leg grounding and hoof visibility in gravel/grass
Edge definition against the busy background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition zone between the shaggy front fur and the smooth rear hide; AI often blurs this boundary unnaturally. Also, verify that the legs do not merge into the belly fur or the ground texture.
